title: Three DHHL wells on Hawaiian Home Lands
summary: On September 29, the Council approved, nine to zero, a committee report advancing the bill for three water wells on Hawaiian Homelands land. Department of Hawaiian Home Lands (DHHL) says the wells, which could produce about 1.728 million gallons a day all for DHHL, would speed homes for its beneficiaries. A testifier said the map shows no pipeline to the planned homestead lands and that a lawsuit may be filed.

timeline.text: Maui Now clarified that the September 29 action was approval of Bill 97, CD1 on first reading only. The agreement still needs second and final reading by the Council and approval from the Hawaiian Homes Commission.
